title: Count Vowels
description: Given a single line string `S`, count and print the total number of vowels (`a`, `e`, `i`, `o`, `u`, both lowercase and uppercase).
input_format: A single line containing the string `S`.
output_format: Print the total count of vowels.

starter_code.python:
import sys

def solve():
    s = sys.stdin.read()
    vowels = set('aeiouAEIOU')
    count = sum(1 for ch in s if ch in vowels)
    print(count)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    solve()
